Biotech, short for biotechnology, refers to the use of biological systems, organisms, or derivatives to develop products and technologies that improve the quality of life, human health, and the environment. It combines biology with technology to harness the power of living systems for practical applications in medicine, agriculture, energy, and environmental conservation. Biotech can involve anything from genetic engineering and gene editing to the development of new vaccines, therapies, and sustainable farming techniques.
